recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast airbrushed illustration featuring a metallic harmonica in the lower right quadrant, emitting a swirling trail of white four-pointed and five-pointed stars that arc toward the upper left corner against a deep black void. The composition is anchored by stylized, chrome-effect script lettering in the upper right.
coreVisualRelationships: The star trail connects the physical instrument to the abstract cosmic space.
The metallic sheen of the harmonica mirrors the chrome texture of the typography.
The diagonal orientation of the harmonica creates a sense of upward momentum.
High contrast between the stark white stars and the absolute black background.
coreInvariants: Deep black background with no visible horizon line.
Star trail composed of varying sizes of sharp-edged white stars.
Chrome/metallic surface rendering with blue and green iridescent highlights.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Harmonica positioned at a 45-degree angle in the bottom right; typography centered in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The detailed, reflective harmonica at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the harmonica, follows the star trail upward and left, then circles back to the display text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black negative space provides a 'deep space' atmosphere.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan and Pale Green (Reflections in chrome)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast; low saturation except for subtle iridescent gradients in metallic surfaces.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm colors like red or orange in the background.
Limit color to the metallic reflections.

letterConstructionRules: Fluid, connected script with thick-to-thin stroke variation.
Letters feature a beveled, 3D chrome effect.
Ascenders and descenders are stylized with sharp, tapered ends.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial capital letter is oversized with a dramatic, sweeping tail.
Lowercase letters have rounded, bulbous counters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone display script; no secondary typeface.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the airbrushed aesthetic of the era.
Allows for the specific liquid-metal look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an airbrushed illustration on a black background. In the bottom right, place a detailed metallic harmonica at a diagonal angle. From the left end of the harmonica, a dense trail of white stars of various sizes should arc upward and toward the top left corner. Use soft airbrush gradients for the chrome reflections on the harmonica.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom script lettering in the upper right. The lettering should have a 3D beveled chrome effect with subtle cyan and pale green iridescent highlights and a soft drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Does the star trail originate from the harmonica?
Does the text have a metallic chrome finish?
Is the harmonica rendered with realistic reflections?

adjustableVariables: Color of the iridescent highlights in the chrome
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the harmonica
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the star trail feels like it is 'flowing' out of the instrument.
Check that the chrome effect on the text matches the chrome on the harmonica.
Verify the composition maintains a strong diagonal balance.
Confirm the stars are pure white against the black.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Musical Instrument] + [Cosmic Star Trail] + [70s Chrome Script] on [Black Background] using [Airbrush Style].
